home_title: Tilt Tower — a one-tap physics tower stacker for your phone
home_desc: Tilt Tower is a one-tap physics game for phones, now in development. A swaying crane drops blocks onto a wobbling tower; stack it as high as you can. One round takes about a minute.
hero_h1: Drop the block. Keep the tower standing.
hero_lead: Tilt Tower is a quick physics game for your phone. A crane swings above a wobbling tower: tap once to drop the block and try to stack it so the tower stays balanced. One round takes about a minute.
hero_note: Not released yet. There is no store page, release date or final price. The name Tilt Tower is provisional.
card1_p: Time one tap to drop the block from the swinging crane. No menus, no tutorial walls.
card2_p: The tower's centre of gravity is visible, so you can see why it wobbles and plan the next block.
card3_p: Short rounds fit any pause. A daily seed gives everyone the same block order for the day.
fact1: Simple physics balance game, single player.
fact2: One tap to play; a round lasts about one minute.
fact3: Free to play, supported by optional rewarded ads.
fact4: Planned for iOS and Android, in 11 languages.
